Schnittstelle Applicable<X,Y>

Typparameter:
X - the input type
Y - the result type
Alle bekannten Unterschnittstellen:
Executable<A>, Fun<X,Y>, MemoisingApplicable<X,Y>, MemoisingFun<X,Y>, Operator<A>, Provider<A>, Receiver<A>, UnsafeProvider<A>
Funktionsschnittstelle:
Dies ist eine funktionale Schnittstelle, die somit als Zuweisungsziel für einen Lambdaausdruck oder eine Methodenreferenz verwendet werden kann.
@FunctionalInterface public interface Applicable<X,Y>

Functional interface for executing an operation on an input value X to produce a result Y.

Execution semantics:

  • Operations may throw checked exceptions (see apply(Object)).
  • Side effects are allowed; Applicable does not require purity or referential transparency. Implementations should document their behaviour.

Safe adaptor: safe() performs the same computation but never throws; failures are returned as Left(Exception), successes as Right(Y) using XorValue.

Memoization: Use MemoisingApplicable only for pure/referentially transparent operations. Memoizing non‑pure operations can yield stale or misleading cached values and missing side effects.

  • Methodendetails

    • applicable

      static <X,Y> Applicable<X,Y> applicable(@NonNull Function<X,Y> function)

      Creates an Applicable from a given Function. The resulting operation applies the function to its input and returns the non‑null result.

      Contract:

      • function must not be null and must not return null.
      • Side effects in function are allowed. If you need memoization, prefer MemoisingApplicable.memoisingApplicable(Applicable) with a pure function.
      Typparameter:
      X - the input type of the function
      Y - the result type of the function
      Parameter:
      function - the function to wrap; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      an Applicable that applies the given function
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if function is null or returns null
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • apply

      Y apply(@NonNull X x) throws Exception

      Executes the operation and returns the result.

      Contract:

      • x must not be null; the result must not be null.
      • Implementations may perform side effects and may throw checked exceptions.
      Parameter:
      x - the input value
      Gibt zurück:
      the computed result
      Löst aus:
      Exception - if an error occurs during execution
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • safe

      default Fun<X, ? extends XorValue<Exception, Y>> safe()

      Returns a function that performs the same computation as apply(Object) but captures failures as XorValue instead of throwing. On success, Right(Y); on failure, Left(Exception).

      Contract:

      • The returned function must never return null.
      • Side effects of the underlying operation still occur during evaluation.
      • Exceptions are not thrown but returned as Left(Exception).
      Gibt zurück:
      a function yielding XorValue<Exception, Y> instead of throwing
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • identity

      static <X> Applicable<X,X> identity()

      Typparameter:

      Gibt zurück:
